faq_heading: Homes near Hellings Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Hellings Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school. Delta School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Hellings Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Hellings Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Hellings Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Immaculate Conception School (0.7 km north-east), Gibson Elementary (0.8 km north-west) and Delta Continuing Education (0.8 km south).

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Hellings Elementary

27 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Hellings Elementary in a straight line (18 elementary, 7 secondary, 2 other; 2 independent). The closest is Immaculate Conception School, 0.7 km away, and the farthest on this list is Sikh Academy, 2.5 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Delta Continuing Education (0.8 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Richardson Elementary (0.9 km). Other elementary schools close by: Immaculate Conception School (0.7 km north-east), Gibson Elementary (0.8 km north-west), Richardson Elementary (0.9 km south-west), Devon Gardens Elementary (1.1 km north-west), McCloskey Elementary (1.3 km south). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Immaculate Conception School, 0.7 km north-east of Hellings Elementary.
